newsitem.title: USA: Knight-Ridder authorizes additional stock buyback.
newsitem.headline: Knight-Ridder authorizes additional stock buyback.

text.p: Knight-Ridder Inc to said Tuesday that it's board of directors has authorized the company to repurchase an additional 10 million shares of its stock.

Combined with the existing authorization to buy back about five million shares, this will allow the company to repurchase up to 15 million shares of its common stock. The company said it will buy these shares in the market from time to time.
Knight-Ridder also said Tuesday that it declared a regular quarterly dividend of $0.20 per share on the company's outstanding common stock. The dividend is payable May 12, record April 30.
